title: Welcome to Islam
description: The foundations: who Allah is, who Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is, the purpose of life, the Shahadah, the Five Pillars, the Six Articles of Faith, and gently addressing common misconceptions.

title: Your First Week
description: Practical first steps: learning Wudu, learning Salah, simple Arabic pronunciation, basic duas, how to enter a mosque, Islamic greetings, and cleanliness.

title: Building Daily Habits
description: Making Islam part of daily life: the five daily prayers, the Quran, dhikr, good manners, family, food and halal, work, and charity.

title: Growing in Knowledge
description: Deeper study for those ready: the Seerah (life of the Prophet), the Companions, Islamic history, the madhhabs, Islamic civilisation, ethics, marriage, finance, and community.

title: Prayer Guide
description: Step-by-step guides to Wudu and Salah, and an overview of the different kinds of prayer in Islamic practice.

title: Fiqh in Daily Life
description: How Islamic jurisprudence (fiqh) actually applies to everyday decisions: earning and business, marriage and divorce, inheritance, food and dress, social dealings, living under secular law, and contemporary issues.

title: Understanding Islam: Addressing Misconceptions
description: Clear, honest answers to the fears and stereotypes about Islam you're likely to meet from family, friends, and colleagues — written to help you understand and explain, not to argue.

title: Christianity and Islam
description: For reverts who came from a Christian background: shared ground, honest differences, and how to talk about your journey with Christian family and friends — written to help you understand and explain, not to argue.
